notes: Corrected: only the target head of the מֵעִמְּךָ unit moves, from the connective *as* to the content word *wilt*, under rule 24's sentence on a fixed English phrase in which no word realizes the morpheme's own lexeme. Edges, statuses and source heads are unchanged.

*it* was read as the object suffix of יְשַׁלְמֶנָּה realized in the recast subordinate clause; the competing reading leaves the suffix unrepresented and the pronoun added, and is named in that unit's note.
